decision.reason: Multiscale memory has the lowest trajectory-level CV error among the non-clock candidates and strong performance across interventions. Memory_clock’s tiny advantage is insufficient evidence for an independent clock; residual lag correlation leaves some uncertainty.
decision.prediction: After input changes, predictions using multiscale history will remain more accurate than state-only predictions, including during rapid switches and pulse recovery.

mapping.target_relation: Accumulated input and output history predict carryover beyond current input and visible state.
mapping.condition_to_check: The storage relation would be weakened if history features failed to improve prediction across distinct interventions.
